source_row.rationale: DVT prophylaxis is particularly emphasized following major lower extremity orthopedic surgery (such as hip or knee replacement) because this surgery is associated with significantly elevated venous thromboembolism risk, making appropriate anticoagulant prophylaxis an important standard of care to help prevent this serious complication.
source_row.source_detail: Elevated VTE Risk in Orthopedic Surgery
source_row.source_name: AAOS/ACCP — VTE Prophylaxis After Major Orthopedic Surgery
